highlights: Own frontend architecture within a five-engineer team for an embedded-insurance platform serving 15+ partners.
Built the no-code UI proof of concept and led its Next.js runtime architecture, enabling supported partner launches and UI changes without frontend deployments.
Shipped SSR quote and payment journeys, configurable data transformations and analytics, and MCP-powered chat-to-form prefill.
Built the shared react-i18next foundation for the India launch and migrated course pages from Django to Next.js.
Delivered Razorpay checkout and shared GA4 instrumentation; introduced MSW mocks, Storybook documentation, and UI-package tooling.
Contributed fixes to the AngularJS seller panel and React-based PaytmMall web application.
Joined as an intern in January 2019, became full-time in July, and progressed from Junior Data Analyst to Frontend Lead.
Built a React supply-chain planning UI with KPI dashboards and role-based access; led the JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration.
Introduced critical-flow tests and GitHub Actions/Docker deployments, reviewed code, and mentored developers and interns.

introduction: Hi, I'm Sudhanshu Ranjan. I'm a senior software engineer with 7+ years building JavaScript and TypeScript applications across insurance, education, and enterprise software.
At Fletch, I own frontend architecture and technical direction while staying hands-on. Outside work, I build local-first Android apps and write about the problems I run into.
Away from the keyboard, I enjoy video games, anime, and reading.

projects.description: A local-first expense tracker that turns transaction SMS messages into draft expenses for you to review on your device.
highlights: Native Kotlin parsing and on-device category suggestions feed a review queue. Raw messages stay on the device, and you approve what gets imported.
Manual entry, custom categories, spending analytics, and multi-currency reporting support everyday tracking.
Optional GitHub sync uses a private repository you control, with incremental transfers and conflict handling.

projects.description: A privacy-first period tracker with encrypted local storage, a calm interface, and optional background sync. No account or analytics required.
highlights: Room and SQLCipher keep data encrypted at rest, with the database key protected by Android Keystore.
Daily logging, calendar views, and searchable history keep recorded entries close at hand.
Optional GitHub sync uses revision-based three-way merging, conflict resolution, and a native WorkManager pipeline.
projects.name: Ritulaya

projects.description: An offline-first app for learning everyday spoken Telugu through English, with Romanized Telugu, short lessons, and daily conversation practice.
highlights: Practice speaking and understanding separately, with FSRS-scheduled reviews and a daily time budget.
Save personal phrases and track recall locally. Installed offline Telugu text-to-speech is optional.
File backups and optional private GitHub backup preserve learning history. The curriculum is still undergoing linguistic review.
